channel.title: Side Quest Co - Bookish Decor and Gifts

item.title: Princess Donut Figure for a Dungeon Crawler Carl Bookshelf
item.description: Princess Donut, sitting on the shelf right next to the books she came from. This is a decorative figure for display, and she suits a bookshelf, a desk or a display cabinet. If you have a Dungeon Crawler Carl reader in your life, she makes a good gift. Each one is made to order in PLA by our small shop in Canada.

item.title: Princess Donut Figure, a Gift for the Dungeon Crawler Carl Fan in Your Life
item.description: If someone you know has read Dungeon Crawler Carl, they already have opinions about Princess Donut. This is a small decorative figure of her, made for a shelf, a desk or a display cabinet, right next to the books where she belongs. We make each one to order here in Canada, in PLA, as a small shop. A good pick when you want to give a fan something that shows you were paying attention.

item.title: Mongo and Princess Donut Figure for a Dungeon Crawler Carl Shelf
item.description: This is Mongo and Princess Donut from Dungeon Crawler Carl, a decorative figure made to sit on a shelf, a desk or in a display cabinet. Each one is made to order by our small shop in Canada, printed in PLA. It works well as a gift for a fellow fan.

item.title: Bluey Inspired Gnomes for Your Bookshelf or Desk
item.description: These are our Bluey inspired gnomes, small decorative figures made for display. They sit well on a bookshelf beside whatever you're reading, on a desk where you take a break between chapters, or in a display cabinet. We make each one to order, printed in PLA. They also make a thoughtful gift for a reader who loves Bluey.

item.title: Long Hair Dachshund Bookends, a Gift for Doxie People
item.description: A pair of long-haired dachshunds to keep the books standing up on a shelf, a nightstand or in a reading corner. If you know someone who loves doxies and always has a book on the go, this is a gift that does a real job every day. Made to order in Canada by our small shop, 3D printed in PLA plastic.
